<thought>Based on the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 211.076 Da, which corresponds to the protonated molecular ion [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the proton mass (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈210.069 Da. The isotopic pattern (≈12 % M+1) suggests about ten carbon atoms. A formula that fits this mass and carbon count is C₁₀H₁₀O₅ (monoisotopic mass 210.0528 Da, within typical experimental error). Therefore the molecular formula is C10H10O5.</thought>
<final_answer>C10H10O5</final_answer>
